description: Na₆Cd₇S₁₀ crystallizes in the monoclinic Cm space group. There are six inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six S atoms to form distorted NaS₆ octahedra that share corners with eight CdS₄ tetrahedra, edges with four NaS₆ octahedra, and edges with four CdS₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.86-3.30 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six S atoms to form NaS₆ octahedra that share corners with six CdS₄ tetrahedra, edges with six NaS₆ octahedra, and edges with six CdS₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.90-3.06 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five S atoms. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.73-2.97 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded to six S atoms to form distorted NaS₆ octahedra that share corners with six CdS₄ tetrahedra, corners with three NaS₄ trigonal pyramids, edges with four NaS₆ octahedra, edges with five CdS₄ tetrahedra, and  a faceface with one NaS₄ trigonal pyramid. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.88-3.18 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded to four S atoms to form distorted NaS₄ trigonal pyramids that share  a cornercorner with one NaS₆ octahedra, corners with eight CdS₄ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent NaS₄ trigonal pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one NaS₄ trigonal pyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 37°. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.82-2.97 Å. In the sixth Na site, Na is bonded to four S atoms to form distorted NaS₄ trigonal pyramids that share corners with two equivalent NaS₆ octahedra, corners with eight CdS₄ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent NaS₄ trigonal pyramids,  an edgeedge with one NaS₄ trigonal pyramid, and  a faceface with one NaS₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 42°. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.69-2.87 Å. There are seven inequivalent Cd sites. In the first Cd site, Cd is bonded to four S atoms to form distorted CdS₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four NaS₆ octahedra, corners with four CdS₄ tetrahedra, corners with four NaS₄ trigonal pyramids,  an edgeedge with one NaS₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one CdS₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 25-51°. There are a spread of Cd-S bond distances ranging from 2.52-2.69 Å. In the second Cd site, Cd is bonded to four S atoms to form CdS₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaS₆ octahedra, corners with four CdS₄ tetrahedra, corners with four NaS₄ trigonal pyramids, edges with three NaS₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one CdS₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 20°. There are a spread of Cd-S bond distances ranging from 2.54-2.57 Å. In the third Cd site, Cd is bonded to four S atoms to form CdS₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four NaS₆ octahedra, corners with four CdS₄ tetrahedra, corners with two NaS₄ trigonal pyramids, edges with three NaS₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent CdS₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 14-45°. There are a spread of Cd-S bond distances ranging from 2.51-2.59 Å. In the fourth Cd site, Cd is bonded to four S atoms to form CdS₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaS₆ octahedra, corners with six CdS₄ tetrahedra, corners with two NaS₄ trigonal pyramids, and edges with three NaS₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 15°. All Cd-S bond lengths are 2.57 Å. In the fifth Cd site, Cd is bonded to four S atoms to form CdS₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four NaS₆ octahedra, corners with six CdS₄ tetrahedra, and edges with three NaS₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 9-56°. There are a spread of Cd-S bond distances ranging from 2.46-2.63 Å. In the sixth Cd site, Cd is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four S atoms. There are a spread of Cd-S bond distances ranging from 2.47-2.77 Å. In the seventh Cd site, Cd is bonded to four S atoms to form distorted CdS₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four NaS₆ octahedra, corners with four CdS₄ tetrahedra, corners with four NaS₄ trigonal pyramids, edges with two equivalent NaS₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent CdS₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 15-64°. There are a spread of Cd-S bond distances ranging from 2.52-2.66 Å. There are ten inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded to four Na and three Cd atoms to form distorted SNa₄Cd₃ pentagonal bipyramids that share edges with two equivalent SNa₃Cd₃ octahedra, edges with two equivalent SNa₄Cd₃ pentagonal bipyramids, and edges with two equivalent SNa₂Cd₃ trigonal bipyramids. In the second S site, S is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four Na and two Cd atoms. In the third S site, S is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to three Na and three Cd atoms. In the fourth S site, S is bonded to three Na and three Cd atoms to form distorted SNa₃Cd₃ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent SNa₃Cd₃ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one SNa₂Cd₃ trigonal bipyramid, edges with five SNa₃Cd₃ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent SNa₄Cd₃ pentagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 12°. In the fifth S site, S is bonded in a distorted pentagonal planar geometry to three Na and two Cd atoms. In the sixth S site, S is bonded to three Na and three Cd atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing SNa₃Cd₃ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 1-57°. In the seventh S site, S is bonded to three Na and three Cd atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing SNa₃Cd₃ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 1-57°. In the eighth S site, S is bonded to three Na and three Cd atoms to form distorted SNa₃Cd₃ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent SNa₂Cd₃ trigonal bipyramids and edges with eight SNa₃Cd₃ octahedra. In the ninth S site, S is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to three Na and three Cd atoms. In the tenth S site, S is bonded to two Na and three Cd atoms to form SNa₂Cd₃ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with three SNa₃Cd₃ octahedra, corners with two equivalent SNa₂Cd₃ trigonal bipyramids, and edges with two equivalent SNa₄Cd₃ pentagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 67-72°.
